objects.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_held_orders_created ON held_orders(created_at DESC)

objects.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_imei_events_imei ON imei_events(imei,at DESC)

objects.name: idx_outbox_signed_drain
objects.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_outbox_signed_drain ON sync_outbox(status,device_id,seq_no) WHERE seq_no IS NOT NULL

objects.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_prod_stock_alert ON products(category,stock,reorder_point) WHERE deleted = 0

objects.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_stock_batches_fifo ON stock_batches(product_id,received_at) WHERE quantity_remaining > 0 AND deleted = 0

objects.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_technician_time_log_repair ON technician_time_log(repair_id,started_at DESC)

objects.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_txn_cust_date ON transactions(customer_id,created_at DESC) WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL AND status != 'VOIDED'

objects.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_txn_items_imei ON transaction_items(imei_number) WHERE imei_number IS NOT NULL

objects.name: idx_txn_orig
objects.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_txn_orig ON transactions(original_transaction_id) WHERE original_transaction_id IS NOT NULL

objects.name: idx_txn_shift_status
objects.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_txn_shift_status ON transactions(shift_id,status) WHERE shift_id IS NOT NULL

objects.name: idx_vendor_disputes_created
objects.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_vendor_disputes_created ON vendor_disputes(created_at DESC)

objects.sql: CREATE INDEX ix_log_unsynced ON event_log(origin) WHERE origin = 'local'

objects.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_one_live_shift_per_device ON cash_sessions(device_id) WHERE status IN ('OPEN','CLOSING')

objects.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_products_idem ON products(idempotency_key)

objects.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_transactions_idem ON transactions(idempotency_key)

objects.name: uq_txn_items_idem
objects.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_txn_items_idem ON transaction_items(idempotency_key)

objects.name: trg_products_fts_delete
objects.sql: CREATE TRIGGER trg_products_fts_delete AFTER DELETE ON products BEGIN DELETE FROM products_fts WHERE id = old.id; END

objects.name: trg_products_fts_insert
objects.sql: CREATE TRIGGER trg_products_fts_insert AFTER INSERT ON products BEGIN INSERT INTO products_fts (id,title,brand,sku,barcode,category) VALUES (new.id,new.title,new.brand,new.sku,new.barcode,new.category); END

objects.name: trg_products_fts_update
objects.sql: CREATE TRIGGER trg_products_fts_update AFTER UPDATE ON products BEGIN UPDATE products_fts SET title = new.title,brand = new.brand,sku = new.sku,barcode = new.barcode,category = new.category WHERE id = new.id; END

objects.name: trg_refund_requires_dedup
objects.sql: CREATE TRIGGER trg_refund_requires_dedup BEFORE INSERT ON transactions WHEN NEW.is_refund = 1 AND COALESCE(NEW.sync_status,'') <> 'synced' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM refund_dedup WHERE refund_id = NEW.id) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'REFUND_BYPASS: refunds must go through refund_sale_atomic'); END

objects.name: order_items
objects.sql: CREATE VIEW order_items AS SELECT * FROM transaction_items

objects.name: orders
objects.sql: CREATE VIEW orders AS SELECT * FROM transactions

objects.name: v_inventory_valuation
objects.sql: CREATE VIEW v_inventory_valuation AS SELECT COUNT(*) as total_skus,COALESCE(SUM(stock),0) as total_units,COALESCE(CAST(ROUND(SUM(stock * cost_price)) AS INTEGER),0) as total_cost_value,COALESCE(CAST(ROUND(SUM(stock * price)) AS INTEGER),0) as total_retail_value,COALESCE(CAST(ROUND(SUM(stock * (price - cost_price))) AS INTEGER),0) as potential_profit_margin FROM products WHERE stock > 0
